title: Suspicious Sudo Privilege Escalation Command
description: Privileged sudo execution of an interactive shell, shadow file read, or netcat utility.
remediation: Verify whether the sudo command was authorized by the user; audit /etc/sudoers and recent process trees.

title: Local User Account Created
description: A new local user account was created on the Linux host via useradd.
remediation: Confirm account creation against IT change tickets; remove unauthorized accounts immediately.
